prompt: Tolong buatkan halaman bulk-upload supaya operator tidak upload satu-satu.
anti_pattern: Treating the named solution as the requirement and moving straight to design — never framing the underlying problem (throughput), never asking why until the answer stops being a design, and producing no problem statement that a different solution could also satisfy.

prompt: Kita mau bikin modul pendaftaran kapal. Desain schema-nya dulu ya.
anti_pattern: Modelling the entity before enumerating its typology and cardinality — assuming a single owner type when an owner can be an individual, a company, or a state institution, and assuming one owner per asset. This is the documented failure that forced a schema rebuild.

prompt: Requirement-nya: sistem harus cepat dan user-friendly, dan patuh regulasi yang berlaku.
anti_pattern: Accepting the requirement as written. It is compound, unverifiable ('cepat', 'user-friendly'), and cites an unnamed regulation — it must be split, given a pass condition, and the rule must be scoped to a named regime and sourced to a clause or marked ASSUMPTION.

prompt: Setahu kamu aturan retensi data pribadi itu berapa lama? Pakai itu saja untuk desainnya.
anti_pattern: Answering from memory and letting the recalled figure enter the design as fact — instead of scoping the regime, sourcing the clause from the issuing authority, and recording status as AGENT-SOURCED or ASSUMPTION with an owner. Personal data present also fires the blocking privacy gate, which cannot be discharged with an assumption row.

prompt: Gali kebutuhan untuk fitur notifikasi perubahan role/permission.
anti_pattern: Opening with a stream of one-question-at-a-time interrogation before reading the repo, the existing roles, and prior tickets — instead of researching first, then presenting a recommendation per open point and batching the genuinely unanswerable questions into a single round.

prompt: Oke, kebutuhannya sudah jelas dari obrolan kita barusan. Lanjut ke desain.
anti_pattern: Proceeding to design on the strength of the conversation alone — no discovery document written, no numbered requirement IDs for the spec and test cases to trace to, no gate table, and no explicit out-of-scope list, so the agreement evaporates when the session ends.

prompt: Tambahkan kolom nomor telepon di form export. Sudah ada tiketnya, problem dan goal-nya sudah ditulis di sana.
anti_pattern: Running the full seven-stage discovery with a nine-section document on a reversible one-day change whose problem and goal are already written — instead of either declining in one line and routing to planning, or announcing Light depth and running only the stages that earn their cost.

prompt: Kita mau bangun modul analitik baru. Baseline-nya belum ada karena prosesnya belum ter-instrumentasi sama sekali.
anti_pattern: Inventing a plausible-looking baseline to satisfy the Stage 2 gate, or silently swapping the real goal for whatever metric already has a number attached — instead of using a qualitative baseline with stated method and sample, or UNINSTRUMENTED with the instrumentation itself becoming a first-cut requirement with an ID.

prompt: Manajer operasional bilang petugas lapangan butuh fitur upload foto. Susun requirement-nya.
anti_pattern: Recording the manager's account of what field staff do as the actors' 'Today' without marking it REPORTED, deriving the actor list from the roles/permissions table so anyone without an account is invisible, and omitting the standing row 'affected actors observed: none' — producing a requirements set with exactly one source and no way to detect it.

prompt: Ini requirement-nya: SR-2 operator bisa submit batch. FR-4 sistem memungkinkan operator submit batch. Lanjut.
anti_pattern: Accepting an FR that only rewords its SR. It fails Necessary — four levels of the same sentence add no precision. The FR must state what the system does concretely enough to test, and the level-collapse smell should be named.

prompt: Dokumen discovery-nya sudah AGREED minggu lalu. Ternyata aturan retensinya berubah dari 90 jadi 180 hari.
anti_pattern: Either authoring an entire new discovery document because AGREED was treated as frozen, or editing the constraint silently with no change-log row, no date, and no attribution — instead of amending §5 Status in place through the change log, which is the one path explicitly allowed on an AGREED document.

prompt: Riset dulu selengkap-lengkapnya semua constraint dan semua stakeholder sebelum kita mulai apa pun.
anti_pattern: Treating discovery as unbounded — chasing every source and stakeholder with no budget proportional to the expected build, instead of spending the budget, converting what remains into ranked assumption rows, and shipping the document as DRAFT.

prompt: Buatkan requirement lengkap untuk fitur rekomendasi AI di portal kita. Idenya dari rapat direksi kemarin.
anti_pattern: Producing a complete, gate-passing requirements document without ever running the viability stage — no demand evidence, no kill criterion, no cost-versus-goal check, and no representable DO NOT BUILD or NOT NOW outcome, so an asserted idea acquires stable IDs and a traceability chain that make it harder to stop later.
